title: Therapeutic potential of proteases in acute lung injury and respiratory distress syndrome via TLR4/Nrf2/NF-kB signaling modulation.
authors: Anwar, Hend Mohamed; Salem, Gad Elsayed Mohamed; Abd El-Latief, Hanan M; Osman, Amany Abd Elhameid; Ghanem, Sahar K; Khan, Haroon; Chavanich, Suchana; Darwish, Alshaymaa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蛋白酶对急性肺损伤的治疗作用，涉及TLR4/Nrf2/NF-kB信号通路，仅用分子对接考察蛋白酶与TLR-4的抑制，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has drawn attention to acute lung injury and respiratory distress syndrome as major causes of death, underscoring the urgent need for effective treatments. Protease enzymes possess a wide range of beneficial effects, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antifibrotic, and fibrinolytic effects. This study aimed to evaluate the potential therapeutic effects of bacterial protease and chymotrypsin in rats in mitigating acute lung injury induced by lipopolysaccharide. Molecular docking was employed to investigate the inhibitory effect of bacterial protease and chymotrypsin on TLR-4, the receptor for lipopolysaccharide. Bacterial protease restored TLR-4, Nrf2, p38 MAPK, NF-kB, and IKK-beta levels to normal levels, while chymotrypsin normalized TLR-4, IKK-beta, IL-6, and IL-17 levels. The expression of TGF-beta, caspase-3, and VEGF in the bacterial protease- and chymotrypsin-treated groups was markedly reduced. Our results suggest that both therapies ameliorate LPS-induced acute lung injury and modulate the TLR4/Nrf2/NF-k signaling pathway. Each protease exhibited distinct mechanisms, with bacterial protease showing a better response to oxidative stress, edema, and fibrosis, whereas chymotrypsin provided a better response in the acute phase and innate immunity. These findings highlight the potential of each protease as a promising therapeutic option for acute lung injury and respiratory distress syndrome.
abstract_zh: COVID-19大流行使急性肺损伤和呼吸窘迫综合征作为主要死亡原因受到关注，凸显了有效治疗方案的迫切需求。蛋白酶具有多种有益效应，包括抗氧化、抗炎、抗纤维化和纤溶作用。本研究旨在评估细菌蛋白酶和胰凝乳蛋白酶在大鼠中缓解脂多糖诱导的急性肺损伤的潜在治疗效果。采用分子对接 (molecular docking) 研究细菌蛋白酶和胰凝乳蛋白酶对脂多糖受体TLR-4的抑制作用。细菌蛋白酶将TLR-4、Nrf2、p38 MAPK、NF-kB和IKK-beta水平恢复至正常，而胰凝乳蛋白酶使TLR-4、IKK-beta、IL-6和IL-17水平正常化。细菌蛋白酶和胰凝乳蛋白酶处理组中TGF-beta、caspase-3和VEGF的表达显著降低。我们的结果表明，两种疗法均能改善LPS诱导的急性肺损伤，并调节TLR4/Nrf2/NF-k信号通路。每种蛋白酶表现出不同的机制，其中细菌蛋白酶对氧化应激、水肿和纤维化的反应更佳，而胰凝乳蛋白酶在急性期和先天免疫方面提供更好的反应。这些发现凸显了每种蛋白酶作为急性肺损伤和呼吸窘迫综合征有前景的治疗选择的潜力。
